deliverables: WP1 - Enabling Onchain Payments & Card Infrastructure
Open-source on-chain payments infrastructure covering smart contract engineering, account abstraction, batched transactions, settlement logic, and wallet/API ecosystem layer
Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances
Stablecoin-backed banking rails and compliance architecture
Milestone-based disbursement controls through TRSC/PSSC tooling
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, for the Wirex project administered by Intersect
request.what: Bringing Real-World Payments to Cardano with Wirex, including open-source payments infrastructure, onchain settlement, Visa card integration, stablecoin-backed banking rails, wallet/API ecosystem components, and oversight through Intersect-administered smart contracts.

claims.claim: Wirex addresses a key Cardano ecosystem gap by providing integrated infrastructure for real-world payments at scale.

The proposal will deliver full-stack open-source payments infrastructure enabling onchain settlement through smart contracts and connections to banking rails, stablecoin systems, and wallet interfaces.
A core outcome is Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances so users can spend digital assets globally at millions of merchants.
Wirex has 7 million users, more than 1.5 million cards issued, over $20 billion in transaction volume, and experience as a Visa Principal Member.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested 3,961,538 ada does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission.
Audit, administration, independent oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls are included through Intersect and technically capable third parties.
Wirex has not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.
The budget allocates 3,846,153 ada to WP1 and 115,385 ada to the Intersect Budget Administration fee.
A treasury dashboard and listed TRSC/PSSC addresses are provided for community audit and on-chain verification of the withdrawn ada.

summary: The document requests 3,961,538 ada for a Wirex real-world payments initiative administered by Intersect, with high-level deliverables, budget totals, governance references, and smart-contract oversight details, but the deterministic assessment identifies missing complete proposal summary, budget analysis, feasibility assessment, risk analysis, alternatives analysis, and failure-mode analysis.
